subject: I wasn't going to share this secret feature
preview_text: Something I built just for the 3AM moments. It's hidden in the app. Don't tell anyone.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. When I was building Fresh Start, I made something for myself. A little hack for the nights when the thoughts wouldn't stop. I never planned to put it in the app. It felt too raw, too personal.

But last week, I was looking at the data. I saw the spike in 'Emergency Mode' usage at 3 AM. And I realized—keeping this to myself was selfish. So I went back into the code. I polished it up. And I quietly added it to your app. Think of it as a secret handshake for the hardest part of the night.

It's called 'Spiral Interrupt.' You won't find it on the main menu. It lives inside Emergency Mode. Tap the heart icon three times. It doesn't do long-term therapy. It does one thing: it derails the obsessive thought train with a single, jarring question designed to break the loop. It's brutally simple.

Go into Emergency Mode and tap the heart three times. Try it next time you feel the spiral starting. It's my gift to you. P.S. This works because it targets the part of your brain stuck on repeat. The first question will feel like a splash of cold water.
cta_text: Open Fresh Start & Find Spiral Interrupt
